scenario: Key generated in the portal authorizes calls at the gateway
Key revoked in the portal is rejected at the gateway
steps: Revoke key in the portal; call gateway

scenario: Plan change in the portal changes the limit at the gateway
steps: Change plan in the portal; call past old limit

steps: Delete application in the portal; call gateway

scenario: Webhook with a bad signature or stale timestamp is rejected
steps: POST /api/internal/v0.9/webhook/events with wrong signature; with timestamp outside tolerance

scenario: Unknown org, oversized body and disabled receiver
steps: Send for unknown org handle; body above max_body_size; with webhook.enabled=false
